name: Multi-Layer Surface Compositing
definition: A compositing method that uses accumulated weight within each surface layer as a coverage measure to compute per-layer opacity, replacing threshold-based clamping with a smooth mapping.
summary: Multi-Layer Surface Compositing converts accumulated Gaussian weights into per-layer coverage opacities to composite surface layers front-to-back, replacing threshold-based clamping with smooth, monotonically increasing mappings to eliminate jagged edges and incorrect blending.
